rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Herisau; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Herisau; other communes in Appenzell Ausserrhoden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Appenzell Ausserrhoden)
rows.label: Profit tax rate, companies and cooperatives (total rate; 50% of the yield goes to the municipalities)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Appenzell Ausserrhoden (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, Art. 77 StG

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Appenzell Ausserrhoden)
rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Appenzell Ausserrhoden)
rows.label: Minimum tax on real estate
rows.value: Legal entities pay a minimum tax on their real estate where it is higher than their profit and capital taxes
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Appenzell Ausserrhoden)
rows.label: Maximum transfer tax rate (municipal tax; municipalities may set a lower rate)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Appenzell Ausserrhoden Steuergesetz (bGS 621.11), Stand 1. Januar 2025, Art. 238

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Appenzell Ausserrhoden)
rows.label: Reduced rate
rows.value: Half the rate for transfers from parents to children, including step- and foster children
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Appenzell Ausserrhoden Steuergesetz (bGS 621.11), Stand 1. Januar 2025, Art. 238
